stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan turns severe; IMD issues red rain warning for coastal Andhra and Odisha
stories.summary: New tonight: Akvan strengthened into a severe cyclonic storm early on Wednesday, about 560 km east of Chennai, and IMD has a red warning for very heavy to extremely heavy rain in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha for two days. It is expected to cross the north Andhra, Yanam and south Odisha coasts on Friday. Andhra has 13 NDRF and 11 SDRF teams on standby, and Railways has opened war rooms; fishermen are told to stay ashore until November 21.
stories.why_it_matters: A strong storm hitting the east coast on Friday threatens lives, crops, ports and rail links.

stories.headline: India signs ₹1,900 crore deal with Israel Aerospace to upgrade Navy's Barak missiles
stories.summary: The Defence Ministry signed a contract worth over ₹1,900 crore with Israel Aerospace Industries to upgrade the Barak point-defence missile system on Indian Navy ships. The deal covers new hardware and software and handles parts that are going out of date. The ministry says it will improve the ships' medium-range air defence.
stories.note: Single source: All India Radio (citing the Defence Ministry).

stories.headline: Rajnath Singh and Jaishankar in Tokyo for India-Japan 2+2 talks on Thursday
stories.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar arrived in Tokyo for the fourth India-Japan 2+2 dialogue on Thursday, focused on defence technology and maritime security. At Raisina Tokyo, Jaishankar pitched India to Japanese investors and named chips, critical minerals, clean energy and defence as areas for deeper ties.

stories.headline: SEBI chief says Indian stock market is worth about $5 trillion
stories.summary: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey told a World Federation of Exchanges meeting in Mumbai that India's listed companies are worth about $5 trillion, about 130% of GDP. He said market value has grown about 16% a year over the past decade and firms have raised about $130 billion a year through shares and bonds.

stories.headline: Xi greets Trump on the tarmac in Shenzhen; three-way talks with Putin on Thursday
stories.summary: New since midday: Trump landed in Shenzhen and Xi met him at the airport, a rare gesture. Opening APEC, Xi backed free trade and promised lower tariffs and wider market access, and said China and Russia should lead a push for a multipolar world. Thursday's Xi-Trump-Putin meeting is expected to focus on the Iran war and Ukraine; China says hopes for concrete results are low.
stories.why_it_matters: Any deal on trade, Iran or Ukraine between the three leaders could move oil, chips and global markets.

image.alt: Xi Jinping waves to the audience at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen

impact.why: Signs of a longer US-China trade truce, or a breakdown, would sway chip and tech stocks.

stories.headline: Iran says it shot down a US drone; UAE tanker attacked in Hormuz, one sailor missing
stories.summary: Iran's army says it downed a US MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz, after US jets hit a Guards missile site on Qeshm island. Separately, ADNOC's shipping arm says one of its vessels was attacked in the strait on Tuesday evening: one crew member is missing and 11 were injured. No one has said who attacked the ship.
stories.why_it_matters: More attacks on Gulf shipping keep a risk premium in oil, which India imports heavily.
stories.note: Drone claim by Iran's army, not confirmed by the US. Tanker details from ADNOC L&S via All India Radio.

impact.why: Fresh attacks on tankers in Hormuz raise supply risk.

stories.headline: Israel starts an operation in central Gaza; Hamas calls it a truce breach
stories.summary: Israel's army says it has begun a concentrated operation in three areas of central Gaza to remove a threat to its troops near the Yellow Line. Hospital officials say three Palestinians were killed, and families fled the north of Nuseirat camp. Hamas called the move a blatant violation of the ceasefire, a day after the Board of Peace warned the truce could collapse.

stories.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it hit 60 Houthi sites as rebels push toward Aden
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition says it struck 60 Houthi military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah, Amran and Saada, including missile tunnels. Yemeni government forces have pulled out of Dhubab airport and the Bab al-Mandeb area as the Houthis advance toward Aden. The Houthis say they hit oil pumping stations near Riyadh; Saudi Arabia has not commented.
stories.note: Single source: Al Jazeera. Strike claims by the coalition and the Houthis are not independently confirmed.

stories.headline: Rupee ends a touch firmer near 93.45 per dollar, giving up an early 93.27 high
stories.summary: The rupee closed at about 93.45 per dollar (PTI: 93.44), a few paise stronger than Tuesday, after touching a seven-month high of 93.27 in the morning. A firmer dollar index near 103.8 and US-Iran tension took back most of the gain, while strong foreign buying of Indian shares, about $10 billion so far in November, kept it supported. Traders are also cutting bets against the rupee in the forward market.
stories.why_it_matters: Steady foreign inflows are keeping the rupee firm even as the dollar stays near a 19-month high.
stories.note: Close given as 93.45 by All India Radio and Business Standard, 93.44 (provisional) by PTI.

impact.why: Foreign share buying keeps supporting the rupee despite a strong dollar.

stories.headline: Dollar index firms to about 103.8 as markets price a December Fed hike
stories.summary: The dollar index rose about 0.3% to near 103.8, close to its 19-month high, with the pound and euro the weakest majors. CME FedWatch shows traders putting about 96% odds on a Fed rate rise in December, ahead of minutes from the Fed's October meeting due at 2 pm New York time.

impact.why: Near-certain Fed hike bets keep the dollar bid.
A firmer dollar limits the rupee's gains.

stories.headline: Sensex falls 500 points to 82,032, Nifty ends at 25,228 as Titan and TCS drag
stories.summary: The Sensex lost 500 points (0.6%) to 82,031.81 and the Nifty fell 159 points to 25,227.95, ending a two-day rise. Titan fell 4.8%, TCS 2.5% and Bajaj Finance and Eternal about 2.5%, while SBI rose 2.3% and ITC 1.4%. Consumer durables and metals were the weakest sectors; the Nifty Midcap 100 lost 1.2%, and losers beat gainers about two to one on the BSE.
stories.why_it_matters: Selling in IT, metals and midcaps shows risk appetite cooling despite record foreign inflows this month.

impact.why: Broad selling, led by metals and consumer stocks, ended a two-day rally.
Titan was the biggest Sensex loser, down 4.8%.
SBI led gains as PSU banks held up.

stories.headline: Dow drops about 0.9% in early trade as Nasdaq gains on Nvidia's results
stories.summary: At about 10:20 am New York time, the Dow was down 0.9% near 50,316, the S&P 500 flat at about 7,341 and the Nasdaq up 0.6%. Nvidia rose nearly 3% after beating forecasts with $115.8 billion in revenue, but later slipped into the red. Take-Two jumped about 7% before Thursday's release of GTA VI, while Lowe's and gold miners fell.
stories.why_it_matters: Wall Street's mood sets the tone for Asian and Indian markets on Thursday morning.

impact.why: Tech gains on Nvidia are offset by rate-hike worries hitting the Dow.
Nvidia's early gain faded after its results beat.

stories.headline: Gold closes 2.3% lower at ₹1.31 lakh; COMEX gold hits lowest since September 2025
stories.summary: Update: by the close, IBJA rates showed 24-carat gold down 2.3% at ₹1,31,164 per 10 grams and silver down 3.2% at ₹1,63,733 a kilo. COMEX gold futures fell about 2.8% to near $3,757 an ounce, and CNBC says spot gold reached its lowest level since September 2025 as Fed hike bets lifted the dollar.

impact.why: A stronger dollar and Fed hike bets are pushing gold to a one-year low.
Silver is falling faster than gold.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting Astra's API price by a fifth
stories.summary: OpenAI launched two models: GPT-6.2 Astra for the hardest professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday tasks, in ChatGPT Work, Codex and its API. Astra's API price falls about 20% to $8 per million input tokens. OpenAI says Astra is its first released model rated 'High' for AI self-improvement risk, and it has tightened safeguards on cybersecurity help.

forex_results.title: Wage Price Index q/q
forex_results.why: Wages rose faster than the 1.0% forecast, the biggest gain since 2023, backing RBA hike bets and the Aussie dollar.

forex_results.title: CPI y/y
forex_results.why: Inflation matched forecasts at a one-year high, keeping a December Bank of England hike in play.
